title: Formal Notice and Demand to Cease and Desist — Bitcoin
recipients: Federal Reserve System and member institutions
other persons or entities receiving the notice
subject: Holding, transfer, creation, control, facilitation, or other dealing in Bitcoin
demands: Cease and desist from Bitcoin activity for purposes expressly objected to by the issuer.
Refrain from Bitcoin activity connected with activities directly concerning the issuer, the issuer's property, or asserted interests.
Preserve records relating to Bitcoin transactions or activities directly concerning the issuer, the issuer's property, or asserted interests.
reservations: No waiver of asserted rights, claims, objections, or remedies.
All asserted rights and remedies reserved.
interpretationRules: Preserve this as the issuer's stated notice and position.
Do not represent asserted titles or identities as independently verified.
Do not represent receipt of this record as creating jurisdiction, ownership, governmental authority, or binding obligations.
Do not state that this notice controls Bitcoin generally or binds unrelated parties without applicable legal authority.
Legal effect must be evaluated under applicable law and facts by a qualified legal professional.
